name: jvs
description: JVS - 一体化个人生活应用骨架：仪表盘 + 可扩展功能模块 + 浏览器 SQLite

scripts.verify:moon: npx esbuild src/core/weather/moon.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.moon-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && npx esbuild src/core/weather/celestial.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.celestial-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && node scripts/verify-moon.mjs
scripts.verify:purge: npx esbuild src/core/db/schema.ts --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.schema-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && npx esbuild src/core/person/purge.ts --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.purge-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && node scripts/verify-purge.mjs
scripts.verify:goal: npx esbuild src/core/goal/logic.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.goal-logic-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && npx esbuild src/core/goal/noteFormat.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.goal-noteformat-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && node scripts/verify-goal.mjs
scripts.verify:atlas: npx esbuild src/core/word/extract.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.word-extract-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && npx esbuild src/core/word/session.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.word-session-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && npx esbuild src/core/word/srs.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.word-srs-for-test.cjs --log-level=error && node scripts/verify-atlas.mjs
